The hedge fund run by Clint Carlson held 472,733 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.47 million, down from 661,612 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Carlson Capital LP who had been investing in Finisar Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.67% or $0.12 $17.87.
